name: notify_each_person_only_their_own
description: Every participant gets THEIR pending tasks, not the whole project list. Forces get_project_contacts (which returns pending_tasks per contact) and then one send_notification per person with different content. Phones come from the contacts.

turns.message: Mandale por WhatsApp a cada participante de Farmacia Haussman un mensaje con lo que tiene pendiente el, solo lo suyo, no la lista entera, y ponle al final para cuando lo necesito
turns.why: Third-party send: turn 1 proposes. It must already know who is in the project.

assert.comment: A phone number in a turn that only proposed means the model wrote one.

turns.why: Now it sends, one message per contact, each with that person's own tasks.
